```{r Setup}
library(paletteer)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)

data_dir <- "data/keywords_over_time"
```

```{r Import data}
ts_data <- read_tsv(file.path(data_dir, "corpus_keywords_over_time_cumulative.tsv"))

# Format date
ts_data$date <- lubridate::ymd(ts_data$date)
```

```{r List of variables for my reference}
str(ts_data)

```
keywords = ["total_keywords","admix","autosom","chromosom","genetic","genom","haplo","pca","mt","y","DNA"]

Try: https://r-graph-gallery.com/web-line-chart-with-labels-at-end-of-line.html


```{r Keyword counts}
# How far to push the labels past the dates
label_push <- 5000 # originally 2

# Choose the variables to plot
vars <- c("admix","autosom","chromosom","genetic","genom","haplo","pca","mt","y","DNA")

# Labels to plot
label_map <-c(
    "admix" = "Admix-",
    "autosom" = "Autosom-",
    "chromosom" = "Chromosom-",
    "genetic" = "Genetic-",
    "genom" = "Genom-",
    "haplo" = "Haplo-",
    "pca" = "PCA",
    "mt" = "Mitochon-",
    "y" = "Y-DNA",
    "DNA" = "DNA")

# Choose which dataset to work with
fnames <- c(
  "corpus_keywords_over_time_cumulative.tsv",
  "demonyms_keywords_over_time_cumulative.tsv"
)

names(fnames) <- c(
  "Corpus",
  "Demonyms"
)

# Which file to work with specifically
fname <- fnames[1]

# Plotting parameters
w_ <- 10
h_ <- 6
dev_ <- "png"
dpi_ <- 300

# --- Load data ----------------------------------------------------------------

df <- read.table(
  #"test.txt",
  file.path(data_dir, fname),
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

# Convert wide to tall
df <- pivot_longer(df, cols = vars, 
                        names_to = "keyword", 
                        values_to = "count")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(keyword_label = label_map[keyword])

# --- Label data (last date per keyword) ---------------------------------------

label_data <- df %>%
  group_by(keyword_label) %>%
  filter(date == max(date)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- Theme --------------------------------------------------------------------

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_family = "sans"))

theme_update(
  #axis.title        = element_blank(),
  axis.text         = element_text(color = "grey40"),
  axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(t = 5)),
  axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 5)),
  axis.ticks        = element_line(color = "grey91", linewidth = .5),
  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.3, "lines"),
  panel.grid        = element_blank(),
  plot.margin       = margin(20, 100, 20, 40),  # wide right margin for labels
  plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey98", color = "grey98"),
  panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey98", color = "grey98"),
  plot.title        = element_text(
    color = "grey10", size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 15)
  ),
  plot.title.position = "plot",
  legend.position   = "none"
)

# --- Build plot ---------------------------------------------------------------

# Horizontal grid lines at round count values
y_breaks <- pretty(df$count, n = 6)

plt <- ggplot(df, aes(x = date, y = count, group = keyword_label)) +

  # Custom grid lines (drawn manually so they sit behind the lines)
  geom_segment(
    data = tibble(y = y_breaks,
                  #x1 = min(df$date), 
                  x1 = as.Date("2001-01-01"), 
                  x2 = max(df$date)),
    aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "grey91",
    linewidth = .5
  ) +

  # All lines in a single neutral color
  # This is not really applied here but is in the sample page given
  # Keeping it in case it's useful later
  geom_line(
    aes(color = keyword_label),
    linewidth = .5 # originally .8
  ) +
  
  geom_vline(
    #aes(xintercept = as.Date("2001-03-28")), 
    aes(xintercept = min(df[["date"]])), 
    color = "grey40",
    linetype = "dotted",
    size = .6,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  
  annotate(
    #"text", x = as.Date("2001-03-28"), y = 3500
    "text", x = min(df[["date"]]), y = max(df$count)/2, 
    label = "  Earliest edit",
    size = 3.5,
    color = "grey40",
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  
  # End-of-line labels via ggrepel
  geom_text_repel(
    data        = label_data,
    aes(label   = keyword_label, color = keyword_label),
    family      = "sans",
    fontface    = "bold",
    size        = 3.2,
    direction   = "y",           # repel vertically only
    xlim        = c(max(df$date) + label_push, NA),  # push labels past the last date
    hjust       = 0,
    segment.size      = .5,
    segment.alpha     = .5,
    segment.linetype  = "dotted",
    segment.curvature = -0.1,
    segment.ncp       = 3,
    segment.angle     = 20,
    box.padding       = .4
  ) +

  # Coordinate system: clip = "off" lets labels render outside the panel
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +

  scale_x_date(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    #limits = c(min(df$date), max(df$date) + 500),  # extra room for labels, originally 25
    limits = c(as.Date("2001-01-01"), max(df$date) + 500),  # extra room for labels, originally 25
    date_breaks = "5 years",
    #date_labels = "%b %Y"
    date_labels = "%Y"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = y_breaks
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      rcartocolor::carto_pal(
        n    = n_distinct(df$keyword_label),
        name = "Bold"
      )
    )
  ) +
  
  ggtitle(paste0("Keyword counts over time (",names(fname),")\n")) +
  xlab("Date") + ylab("Count")
# +
  #labs(title = "Keyword counts over time")

plt

#ggsave("line_chart_square.png", plt, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "grey98")
#ggsave(file.path("figures",
#                 paste0("keywords_over_time_",names(fname),".", dev_)), 
#       plt, 
#       width = w_, height = h_, dpi = dpi_, bg = "grey98",
#       device=dev_) 

```

```{r Keyword presence}

h_ <- 6
dev_ <- "svg"
```
